question: Câu 601: The doctors are operating on the boy ________ fingers were lost because of firecrackers.
explanation: Đại từ quan hệ. Phía sau đại từ quan hệ là danh từ nên phải dùng “whose” (+ N) thay thế cho sở hữu cách. => The doctors are operating on the boy whose fingers were lost because of firecrackers. Tạm dịch: Các bác sĩ đang phẫu thuật cho cậu bé bị mất ngón tay do pháo nổ.

question: Câu 602: I was very angry. My friend John refused ______ me a lift as he had promised.
explanation: To-Infinitives. Dấu hiệu: refuse to do sth (từ chối làm gì). => I was very angry. My friend John refused to give me a lift as he had promised. Tạm dịch: Tôi đã rất tức giận. Bạn tôi, John đã từ chối nâng đỡ tôi như đã hứa.

question: Câu 603: "Where do you think Rooney is today?". "I have no idea. He ________ late."
explanation: Động từ khuyết thiếu với nghĩa phỏng đoán trong quá khứ. may have Vp.p: có thể đã làm gì. => He may have slept late. Tạm dịch: “Bạn nghĩ hôm nay Rooney ở đâu?”. “Tôi không biết. Có lẽ anh ấy đã ngủ muộn.”

question: Câu 604: The firm spent thousands dollars wining and dining ________ clients.
explanation: Tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ “clients”. potential (adj): tiềm năng. => The firm spent thousands dollars wining and dining potential clients. Tạm dịch: Công ty đã chi hàng ngàn đô la để chiêu đãi và tiếp cận khách hàng tiềm năng.

question: Câu 605: The unlucky cheater showed ______ used airline ticket but he was caught.
explanation: Mạo từ không xác định. Danh từ “ticket” số ít, lần đầu nhắc tới, không xác định => a/an. “used” bắt đầu bằng phụ âm /ju:zd/ nên dùng “a”. => The unlucky cheater showed a used airline ticket but he was caught.

question: Câu 606: 'Do you care very much about what other people think?'—'____________________. I obsess about others' comments about me.'
explanation: Từ chỉ số lượng. Too much + N không đếm được (bổ nghĩa cho động từ care). Dựa vào ngữ cảnh, đáp án B phù hợp nhất. => 'Too much. I obsess about others' comments about me.'

question: Câu 607: I haven't seen Peter for a long time. I will ________ him this weekend.
explanation: Phrasal verb. call on (v): ghé thăm. => I will call on him this weekend. Tạm dịch: Tôi đã không gặp Peter lâu rồi. Tôi sẽ ghé thăm anh ấy vào cuối tuần này.

question: Câu 608: She is so absent-minded. She ________ her cell phone three times.
explanation: Thì Hiện tại hoàn thành. Dấu hiệu: three times (nhấn mạnh số lần từ quá khứ đến hiện tại). Cấu trúc: have/has + Vp.p. => She has lost her cell phone three times.

question: Câu 609: Bell experimented with ways of transmitting ______ over a long distance.
explanation: Danh từ làm tân ngữ sau động từ “transmitting”. speech (n): lời nói. => Bell experimented with ways of transmitting speech over a long distance.

question: Câu 610: If energy ______ inexpensive and unlimited, many things in the world would be different.
explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2 (không có thật ở hiện tại). Dấu hiệu: If + would. Cấu trúc: If S + V (QKĐ), S would V. => If energy were inexpensive and unlimited...

question: Câu 611: High interest rates ______ people in capitalist countries from borrowing money.
explanation: Từ vựng. discourage (v): ngăn cản, làm nản lòng. => High interest rates discourage people... from borrowing money. Tạm dịch: Lãi suất cao làm người dân ở các nước tư bản nản lòng khi vay tiền.

question: Câu 612: Most of the participants can't help ______ why the president spoke so angrily.
explanation: Gerund. can't help + Ving: không thể không. => Most of the participants can't help wondering why the president spoke so angrily.

question: Câu 613: When he was a student, his father gave him a monthly ______ towards his expenses.
explanation: Từ vựng. allowance (n): trợ cấp. => ... a monthly allowance towards his expenses. Tạm dịch: Khi còn là sinh viên, cha anh đã cho anh một khoản trợ cấp hàng tháng để trang trải chi phí sinh hoạt.

question: Câu 614: The teacher is considering whether to choose Nike or Jackie as class president.
explanation: Từ gần nghĩa. consider (v): suy xét, cân nhắc cẩn thận = thinking over. => considering = thinking over.

question: Câu 615: People who defaulted on their homes repossessed if they do not make their mortgage payments.
explanation: Từ gần nghĩa (theo đáp án đề). defaulted (v): vỡ nợ, phá sản. Đáp án được chọn là A theo key.

question: Câu 616: In some parts of the world, even pure water is something rare and valuable. It's time the government took precautions against pollution.
explanation: Từ trái nghĩa. pure (a): tinh khiết, sạch >< contaminated (a): bị ô nhiễm. => pure << contaminated.

question: Câu 617: When I suggested he was mistaken, John got hot under the collar and stormed out of the room.
explanation: Thành ngữ trái nghĩa. got hot under the collar: tức giận, điên tiết >< remained calm: giữ bình tĩnh.

question: Câu 618: Mom: “It’s time to get up” Son: “_________”
options: Let me sleep on for ten minutes.
I’ve overslept. I’m going to be late.
explanation: Tình huống giao tiếp. Mẹ bảo dậy, con xin ngủ thêm 10 phút là phù hợp nhất.

question: Câu 619: Greg: “Kate, Giga Mall is having a big sale this week. You wanna go?” Kate: “_________”
options: I hope it stays like this.
I feel bad when hearing that.
I am felling sad. I’ve just broken up.
I don’t feel like it. I’m broke.
explanation: Tình huống giao tiếp. Từ chối lời mời đi mua sắm vì hết tiền (I’m broke) là phù hợp.

question: Câu 620: Michael: “OMG, I could not bear it any more. The itch on my arm is turning worse” Halley: “_________”
options: I enjoy the free medical care.
Why don't you go to the dermatologist?
Shall I accompany you to the dentist?
explanation: Tình huống giao tiếp. Khuyên đi khám bác sĩ da liễu vì bị ngứa cánh tay là phù hợp.

question: Câu 621: Lucky: “____________________” David: “Oh, about 25 minutes usually.”
options: How long does the talk have to be?
How long have you live here?
explanation: Tình huống giao tiếp. Câu hỏi về thời lượng bài thuyết trình phù hợp với câu trả lời “khoảng 25 phút”.

question: Câu 622: A good memory is often seen as something that comes naturally, and a bad memory as something that cannot be changed, but actually (622) ___________ to improve your memory.
options: these is a lot that you can do
there is a lot that you can do
what is a lot that can you do
A lot is that you can do
explanation: Mệnh đề danh từ. Cấu trúc There + be ... (có...). Đáp án B đúng ngữ pháp và ngữ cảnh.

question: Câu 623: This no doubt explains the reason why schoolboys remember football results (623) ________ but struggle with dates from their history lessons!
explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ “remember”. effortlessly (adv): một cách dễ dàng.

question: Câu 624: Take an active interest in what you want to remember, and (624) __________.
explanation: Song song với “Take an active interest...” (mệnh lệnh). Theo key đáp án C được chọn.

question: Câu 625: Physical exercise is also important for your memory, because it increases (625) _________ and sends more oxygen to your brain.
explanation: Tính từ sở hữu. Đại từ chính trong bài là “you” nên dùng “your heart rate”.

question: Câu 626: Exercise also reduces stress, (626) ___________.
options: that is very bad for the memory
which is very bad for the memory
explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ. Theo key đáp án C được chọn (dù giải thích có nhắc đến which).

question: Câu 627: To talk and also (627) _________ by other people, we have to speak a language...
explanation: Song song với “To talk” và bị động (by other people) => to be understood.

question: Câu 628: Communication would be impossible (628) ______________.
options: because everyone made up their own language
when everyone made up their own language
if everyone made up their own language
that everyone made up their own language
explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2. If + S + V-ed, S + would + V. => if everyone made up their own language.

question: Câu 629: But (629) __________, the more precise you can be about their exact meaning.
options: the most idea you can express
you can express the more idea
the more idea can you express
the more idea you can express
explanation: Cấu trúc so sánh kép: The more + N + S + V, the more + adj + S + V.

question: Câu 630: (630) ____________________.
options: The way we say the words is also very important
The way is we say the words is also very important
We say the words is the way that is also very important
We say the words the way is also very important
explanation: Mệnh đề danh từ. “The way we say the words is also very important” đúng ngữ pháp.

question: Câu 631: (631) ____________________ of voice can express many emotions and show whether we are pleased or angry, for instance.
explanation: Tính từ sở hữu. Chủ ngữ “we” => Our tone of voice.

question: Câu 632: Give people your helping hand; you'll get it back when you are in need.
options: You should help other people, in case you'll need to be helped back.
If you help other people, they will ask for your help when they need it again.
Unless you help other people, you won't be helped when you need it.
If I were you, I would help all people who ask for my help.
explanation: Viết lại câu. Ý: Hãy giúp đỡ mọi người; bạn sẽ nhận lại khi cần. Đáp án A đúng nghĩa nhất (in case).

question: Câu 633: It is believed that people with mental health conditions, all over the world, are seen to be good and efficient workers.
options: People with mental health conditions, all over the world, are believed to see to be good and efficient workers.
People with mental health conditions, all over the world, are believed to be seen to be good and efficient workers.
People with mental health conditions, all over the world, is believed to be seen to be good and efficient workers.
People with mental health conditions, all over the world, is believed to see to be good and efficient workers.
explanation: Câu bị động khách quan. S + am/is/are + believed + to be Vp2. => are believed to be seen...

question: Câu 634: The boy was not intelligent enough to have solved such complex problems alone.
options: The complex problems couldn't be solved because the boy was so stupid.
The boy was not intelligent but he managed to solve such complex problems.
The boy, though quite intelligent, couldn't solve the complex problems in his own.
The boy together with someone else solved the complex problems because he was not intelligent.
explanation: Viết lại câu. Không đủ thông minh để giải một mình => phải có người khác cùng giải. Đáp án D đúng nghĩa.

question: Câu 635: There is no more convenient way to get there than by taking the subway.
options: Taking the subway is the most convenient way to get there.
No more way to get there is the most convenient than taking the subway.
Taking the subway is no more convenient than any ways to get there.
There is only by taking the subway to get there conveniently.
explanation: So sánh. “no more ... than” = the most. => Taking the subway is the most convenient way...

question: Câu 636: Perhaps I saw Linda dating with your ex-boyfriend at Roses Restaurant last night.
options: It might be Linda who dated with your ex-boyfriend at Roses Restaurant last night.
It must have been Linda dating with your ex-boyfriend at Roses Restaurant last night.
It was probably Linda who was on a date with your ex-boyfriend at Roses Restaurant last night.
Nobody but Linda dated with your ex-boyfriend at Roses Restaurant last night.
explanation: Phỏng đoán quá khứ. perhaps = probably. Đáp án C đúng mức độ và thì.

question: Câu 637: He lacked commitment to the job. He wasn't considered for promotion.
options: But for his lack of commitment to the job, he would have been considered for promotion.
Suppose that he lacked commitment to the job, he wouldn't be considered for promotion.
If it had not been for his lack of commitment to the job, he would be considered for promotion.
Without his commitment to the job, he would be considered for promotion.
explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3 với “But for”. => But for his lack of commitment..., he would have been considered...

question: Câu 638: Some kinds of fish live in fresh water. Others live in sea water.
options: Some kinds of fish live in fresh water, for others live in sea water.
Some kinds of fish live in fresh water, and others live in sea water.
Some kinds of fish live in fresh water, so others live in sea water.
Some kinds of fish live in fresh water, or others live in sea water.
explanation: Liên từ. Hai ý ngang hàng => dùng “and”.

question: Câu 639: She tried very hard to pass the driving test. She could hardly pass it.
options: Despite being able to pass the driving test, she didn't pass it.
No matter how hard she tried, she could hardly pass the driving test.
Although she didn't try hard to pass the driving test, she could pass it.
She tried very hard, so she passed the driving test satisfactorily.
explanation: Kết hợp câu. “No matter how hard...” diễn tả dù cố gắng đến đâu cũng gần như không vượt qua được.

question: Câu 640: He behaved in a very strange way. That surprised me a lot.
options: He behaved in a very strange way, that surprised me a lot.
His behavior was a very strange thing, that surprised me most.
He behaved very strangely, which surprised me a lot.
I was almost not surprised by his strange behavior.
explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định. which thay thế cả mệnh đề phía trước. => He behaved very strangely, which surprised me a lot.

question: Câu 641: What is the passage mainly about?
options: The importance of social media posts.
Ways of following social media trends.
The increase in the number of social media users in the world.
Ways of becoming a social media influencer.
explanation: Đọc hiểu toàn bài. Đoạn văn đưa ra 5 tips để trở thành influencer. Đáp án D.

question: Câu 642: In paragraph 1, what does the word them refer to?
explanation: Tham chiếu. “more and more people are keen to become influencers, too. If you are one of them” => them = influencers.

question: Câu 643: In paragraph 2, what is the word niche closest in meaning to?
explanation: Từ gần nghĩa. niche = suitable field (lĩnh vực phù hợp/ngách).

question: Câu 644: What can be inferred from paragraph 3?
options: Instagram and Snapchat are the most popular platforms with bloggers.
Bloggers and micro-bloggers are the best influencers.
Influencers good at biology can gain the most attention.
Some influencers are not bloggers or micro-bloggers.
explanation: Suy luận. “Most influencers these days are bloggers and micro-bloggers” => một số không phải. Đáp án D.

question: Câu 645: In the passage, which activity is advised for connecting with followers?
explanation: Chi tiết. “Tell an interesting story... help them connect with you.” => Story telling.

question: Câu 646: What does the word “they” in paragraph 2 refer to?
explanation: Tham chiếu. “Mobile phone companies are worried... They say that...” => they = companies.

question: Câu 647: According to paragraph 3, which is TRUE about the salesman?
options: He had a problem with memory.
He had to retire because of his age.
explanation: Chi tiết. “had to retire at young age because of serious memory loss” => He had a problem with memory.

question: Câu 648: According to the passage, what can be inferred about cellphones?
options: Cellphones are very popular with young people because they are a means of communication.
Cell phones may change their users' social behaviours
Those who use cellphones too often may suffer memorial problems.
Cellphone should be only used in medical emergencies.
explanation: Suy luận từ ví dụ người bán hàng dùng 6 giờ/ngày bị mất trí nhớ nghiêm trọng.

question: Câu 649: What is the word “potentially” in paragraph 4 closest in meaning to?
explanation: Từ gần nghĩa. potentially = possibly (có khả năng).

question: Câu 650: What could be the most suitable title for the passage?
options: Mobile Phones: A Must of Our Time
The Reasons Why Mobile Phones Are Popular
explanation: Tiêu đề. Bài đề cập cả lợi ích và tác hại (giá phải trả) của điện thoại di động. Đáp án A phù hợp nhất.
